reading.title: A Different Saturday
reading.text: Every Saturday, Lena used to take the bus to a shopping centre with her sister. Last spring, she saw a notice at the library asking for volunteers at a community garden. She wanted to learn how to grow vegetables, so she decided to try it for one morning. The garden opened at nine, but Lena arrived early to meet the organiser, Sam. He showed her where to find tools and paired her with another volunteer. They planted tomatoes and carried water to the plants. By midday, Lena was tired but pleased. She went back the next week and now spends two Saturdays a month there. Her sister sometimes joins her. The garden gives half of its vegetables to a local café, which uses them to make free meals.
questions: Where did Lena see the notice?
Matnning ikkinchi gapida notice kutubxonada ko‘rilgani aytilgan.
Why did Lena first try volunteering?
She wanted to learn how to grow vegetables — sabab to‘g‘ridan to‘g‘ri berilgan.
Lena arrived after the garden opened.
Lena arrived early — u ochilishdan oldin keldi.
How often does Lena volunteer now?
Two Saturdays a month — oyiga ikki shanba.
The café pays the garden for the vegetables.
Sabzavotlar kafega berilishi aytilgan, to‘lov haqida ma’lumot yo‘q.

listening.title: A Visit to the Art Centre
listening.text: Hello. This is the Oak Street Art Centre calling about your visit on Friday. The centre usually opens at nine, but your group should arrive at ten in the morning. Please wait by the main entrance. Do not go to the car park to meet your guide. The first part of the visit is a short talk about the building. After that, you can join a painting workshop. The workshop is in room twelve, next to the library. You do not need to bring paint or paper. We provide both. You should bring a bottle of water because the café is closed for repairs this week. Lunch is at one. You can eat in the garden if the weather is good. At two, the guide will show you the new photography room. If you cannot come, please call the office on Thursday before five.
questions: What time should the group arrive?
Guruh uchun umumiy ish vaqtiga emas, ten in the morning ko‘rsatmasiga qarang.
Where should they meet the guide?
Main entrance uchrashuv joyi sifatida berilgan.
Materiallar beriladi, kafe yopiq bo‘lgani uchun suv kerak.
Lunch is at one — tushlik vaqti.
When should someone call to cancel?
Thursday before five — bekor qilishning oxirgi vaqti.

reading.title: The Library After Dark
reading.text: When the district library extended its opening hours, the council expected most new visitors to be office workers. In practice, the most frequent evening visitors were students sharing crowded homes. They came for a quiet desk rather than for books. To make the trial affordable, the library opened only its main reading room after seven. Volunteers helped people find desks, but a qualified member of staff stayed in the building throughout. During the first month, the library recorded the number of visits and asked users why they came. Attendance was high, although it fell during a week of heavy rain. The council had originally planned to make the service permanent if more than a hundred people used it each week. It is now also considering the cost of keeping the room warm in winter. A final decision will be made after another month of data.
questions: Who came most often in the evening?
Most frequent visitors bilan kutilgan guruhni ajrating.
Rather than for books qarama-qarshi ma’noni bildiradi.
Volunteers were the only people working after seven.
A qualified member of staff stayed — xodim ham bor edi.
Although it fell during a week of heavy rain — pasayish shu haftada bo‘lgan.
The council has approved the service for next winter.
A final decision will be made after another month — qaror hali oldinda.

listening.title: A Hotel Reservation
listening.text: Good afternoon. I booked a room for Friday and Saturday, but my conference has been moved to the following week. I would like to keep the same room type if possible. The receptionist explained that a double room was available on the new Friday, but not on Saturday. There was a twin room available for both nights. I preferred that to moving rooms, so I asked her to change the booking. She said the first night would cost the same as before. The second night would be ten pounds more because of a local festival. Breakfast was included, but parking was not. I asked about coming by train instead. The station is fifteen minutes away on foot. The receptionist said she would send a confirmation by email that afternoon. She told me to call again if it had not arrived by the next morning.
questions: Why is the guest changing the reservation?
The first room was too expensive
The conference has been moved — o‘zgarish sababi.
Which room does the guest choose?
They prefer the twin room to changing rooms.
Why does the second night cost more?
Because of a local festival — qo‘shimcha narx sababi.
How far away is the station on foot?
Fifteen minutes away on foot — piyoda masofa.
When should the guest call back?
If the email is missing the next morning
If it had not arrived by the next morning — qayta qo‘ng‘iroq sharti.

reading.title: When a Pilot Succeeds
reading.text: A university piloted an optional online feedback tool in three introductory courses. At the end of the term, students who used the tool submitted their final projects earlier than students who did not. The department initially interpreted this as evidence that the tool encouraged better planning. The researchers, however, noted that students had chosen whether to use the tool. Some might already have been more organised or more comfortable asking for feedback. The difference therefore could not be attributed entirely to the software. The team also found that one course had offered a bonus for early submission, which was not part of the trial design. For the next trial, the team proposed offering access by lottery and removing the bonus. It also suggested interviewing students who stopped using the tool halfway through. Their experiences could reveal barriers that a comparison of submission dates would overlook.
questions: What did the department initially infer?
Initially interpreted — bo‘limning birinchi xulosasi berilgan.
Users could already be more organised
Teachers selected the courses at random
Foydalanuvchilar avvaldan farq qilgan bo‘lishi mumkin, bu natijani izohlashi mumkin.
All three courses offered an early-submission bonus.
Why interview students who stopped using the tool?
To find barriers hidden by submission dates
To ask them to submit earlier
To determine the cost of a lottery
Comparison of submission dates would overlook — raqamlar ko‘rsatmagan sabablarni topish.
The next trial has already been carried out.
The team proposed — matnda kelajakdagi sinov taklif qilingan.

listening.title: A Transport Pilot
listening.text: The committee will discuss the results of the Riverside bus pilot on Thursday. At first sight the results seem encouraging. Passenger numbers went up by twelve percent, and more people reported that they could reach the hospital without changing buses. However, we should be careful about what the figures prove. During the pilot the city was repairing the main road, so some drivers might have switched to buses temporarily. The transport office also introduced a discounted monthly pass on every route, not just the one being tested. The researchers therefore recommend continuing the pilot into the autumn and comparing its route with two routes that did not receive additional services. They are not recommending a permanent timetable yet. The new report should also separate weekday journeys from weekend journeys, because the hospital timetable and leisure travel create different patterns. The committee will vote on the extra monitoring period, not on a permanent change.
questions: Passenger numbers went up by twelve percent — ijobiy kuzatuv.
They may explain part of the rise
They increased the cost of the pass
Ta’mirlash haydovchilarni vaqtincha avtobusga o‘tkazgan bo‘lishi mumkin.
The discounted pass was only available on the pilot route.
On every route — barcha yo‘nalishlarga tatbiq etilgan.
What do researchers propose for autumn?
Comparing the pilot with two other routes
Taqqoslash qo‘shimcha xizmatlar ta’sirini ajratishga yordam beradi.
What will the committee vote on?
Extra monitoring period — doimiy o‘zgarishdan farqli qaror.
